Non-invasive MCP accelerator plugin for Google Antigravity (CLI/Desktop/IDE): cuts LLM turns (-34%), token quota (-31%), and upload traffic (-40%) without affecting native UI or diffs.

Agent skill: turn four pixel art views into fake-3D sprites you can spin. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Pi.

Detection rules and IOCs for AI agent attack frameworks: ARTEX, Cairn, PentAGI, HexStrike, CyberStrikeAI, Strix, Hermes Agent, Agent Zero, RedAmon, Xalgorix, Pentest Swarm AI. KQL hunts for Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, YARA, Splunk, Elastic, STIX 2.1.
A training engine for your local model, using your idle compute
Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP, routines and approvals. macOS, Windows, Linux + Android. Built on pi.
Open, agent- and model-agnostic artifacts, all saved locally as plain files — edit, comment on, and export slides, UI designs, design systems, whiteboards, sheets, dashboards, docs, and motion.
Agent as Director: cuts, Blender proxies and sound, from script to film. One skill and one plugin for coding agents.
